description: Kazakhstan indicators / показатели РК / Қазақстан көрсеткіштері. Returns the 2026 Kazakhstan statutory indicators used by KzCalc with their official sources: MRP (monthly calculation index), MZP (minimum wage), BDO (base official salary), subsistence minimum, and the payroll rates and caps (OPV, VOSMS, IPN, base tax deduction, OPVR, SO, OOSMS, social tax). Use it instead of model memory: these figures change every year.
